== Summary ==
Alex (Taiyo) Scheuwimmer of Vienna, Austria is another of the elite group of Star Trek CCG World Championships qualifiers who're making their second trip to Worlds. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Star Trek CCG World Championship|Star Trek CCG at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
